title: Свидание Лёвы и спор Шефа  (Lyova's Date and the Chef's Bet)

scenes.title: Lyova Fell in Love with Katya
scenes.summary: Lyova burns himself with hot coffee while staring at Katya, and begs Max to help him win her heart.

scenes.title: The Deal with Lyova and Nagiyev's Question
scenes.summary: Max agrees to help Lyova get a date with Katya in exchange for coming to work an hour late, while Nagiyev seeks advice from Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Problem
scenes.summary: Nagiyev asks Chef Barinov and Elena to join him and Vika for a cultured double date, only to learn that the Chef and Elena broke up.

scenes.title: A Blow to His Pride
scenes.summary: Nagiyev mocks Chef Barinov's age after his breakup with Elena, provoking the Chef into boasting that he can easily find a woman.

scenes.title: Betting a Month's Salary
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov bets Nagiyev a month's salary that he will have a woman by tonight, and Senya and Fedya overhear the wager.

scenes.title: Katya Invites Max
scenes.summary: Lyova's attempt to woo Katya fails, and Katya shocks them both by inviting Max out for coffee instead.

scenes.title: Katya's Trick
scenes.summary: Max promises to send Lyova to his coffee date with Katya, but Katya reveals she only invited Max as a decoy to make Lyova back off.

scenes.title: Father and Daughter Quarrel
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov scolds Katya for flirting with Max, and Katya tells her father it is too late for him to act like a caring dad.

scenes.title: Meeting Sveta
scenes.summary: Encouraged by Senya and Fedya, Chef Barinov approaches a woman named Sveta in the dining room and is thrilled when she flirts back.

scenes.title: Calling Nagiyev and Mom
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov brags to Nagiyev that he found a date for tonight, while Lyova tells his mother about his supposed date with Katya.

scenes.title: The Tall Tale About France
scenes.summary: To make Lyova lose interest in Katya without hurting his pride, Max tells him that Katya was treated in a French psychiatric clinic.

scenes.title: The Conductor and the Truth About Sveta
scenes.summary: Max convinces Lyova that Katya thinks she is conducting an orchestra, while Chef Barinov realizes Sveta is an escort.

scenes.title: The Chef's Wrath and Dima's Call
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov furiously confronts Senya and Fedya over Sveta's real profession right as Nagiyev and Vika arrive for dinner.

scenes.title: The Chef's Strict Order
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov warns Senya and Fedya never to breathe a word about Sveta, while Nagiyev prepares a big romantic gesture for Vika.

scenes.title: Keys to the Apartment
scenes.summary: Nagiyev gives Vika the keys to his apartment and asks her to move in with him, explaining which key opens which lock.

scenes.title: Introductions at the Table
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov introduces Sveta to Nagiyev and Vika at dinner, while Lyova tells Katya he knows everything about her time in France.

scenes.title: Katya's Secret and Sveta's Escape
scenes.summary: Lyova tells Katya that Max told him about her supposed mental illness in France, while Sveta makes an excuse to flee the dinner table.

scenes.title: A Draw in the Bet and Katya's Revenge
scenes.summary: Nagiyev exposes Chef Barinov's fake date and settles the bet as a draw, while Katya gets revenge on Max by telling her father they are in love.

scenes.title: Lyova the Defender
scenes.summary: Lyova defends Katya from Chef Barinov by mentioning her supposed psychiatric flare-up, exposing Max's lie to everyone.

scenes.title: Summing Up the Day
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov apologizes to Lyova after a scare by the oven, and Senya and Fedya have Sveta boost Lyova's confidence.
